verdict.rationale: Groq documents its own tool/function calling: JSON-schema tool definitions passed via the `tools` parameter, function calling in the OpenAI-compatible Responses API, and remote MCP tool use where Groq handles the orchestration. Strict constrained decoding is documented for structured outputs. Parallel tool calls and client-side multi-step loop reliability are not documented, and there is no independent evidence that tool calling is faithful on open models. missing for 10: documented parallel tool calling, explicit multi-step/agent-loop tool-use docs, strict schema adherence specifically for tool-call arguments, hands-on corroboration of tool-call reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — including parallel and multi-step tool use — so agent loops run on open models without breaking
